description: This Java class defines a log filter named MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements the LogNode interface. Its purpose is to filter log messages to only pass along the message content itself, omitting any metadata or metadata.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter that forwards only the message part of log entries to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message to pass only the message text to the next node, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
